LOOK: Akbayan Party-list staged a demonstration along EDSA, calling for an end to corruption in the country. Protesters also handed out white ribbons as a symbol of their advocacy.

The protest coincides with the National Day of Action Kontra Korapsyon, amplifying the call for accountability.
